independent_method: No pipeline helpers imported. Statistics reconstructed from CSV; identity, latent arrays and all record hashes checked; census trim/owner/terminal predicates independently reconstructed directly from traces.

code.manual_review: Only method choices and strict conditioned identity validation change inference; post worker, validity, sampling and timeout functions are AST-identical. All raw metric functions match after normalizing one descriptive string.

fit_only.source_step_hash_limitation: Checks protect assets since this evaluation's reuse snapshot, not against unrecorded historical mutations.

optimized.source_step_hash_limitation: Checks protect assets since this evaluation's reuse snapshot, not against unrecorded historical mutations.

stratified_failure_mechanisms.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive stratification, not a preregistered causal test; full evaluation metrics and the dynamically derived main failure denominator are unchanged. Exact adjacency checks only face-pair adjacency, not complete B-Rep topology or boundary geometry.
